description: [Signal Desk] Two tickers side by side on the current signal, with which of the two carries the stronger reading (`stronger`; EI magnitudes within 0.05 of each other are `comparable`). For questions like 'AAPL or MSFT'; falpha_screener_desk ranks more than two names. Available without an account.

horizon.description: Holding period the reading is for, in trading days: hp5d (5), hp15d (15), hp2m (42, about two calendar months).
horizon.title: Horizon

regime.description: Market backdrop the model conditions on: neutral (no market view), bull or bear.
regime.title: Regime

ticker_a.description: US-listed equity symbol in fAlpha's covered universe, e.g. NVDA. falpha_screener_desk_coverage reports whether a symbol is covered.
ticker_a.title: Ticker A

ticker_b.description: US-listed equity symbol in fAlpha's covered universe, e.g. NVDA. falpha_screener_desk_coverage reports whether a symbol is covered.
ticker_b.title: Ticker B

name: falpha_signal_desk_compare
title: Compare two signals
